adaptation_rules: one headline + one supporting line (+ optional figures/stat/badge/brand slot/inset); no CTA/price/badges (ignored with note)

designed headline breaks (en): the copy's \n wins; otherwise every split into ≤maxLines is scored — a line never ends on a function word (with/and/for/of/the/to…), a break before one is preferred, a break between two content words costs 12, a lone last word 30, 3 lines 8; each size step down costs 4, so the type shrinks before a worse split is taken; the browser's own wrap is a last resort (score 200)
two-tone: [[words]] mark the accent words; unmarked copy: first designed line cream/ink, the rest accent

zh: no uppercase, CJK font, the copy's \n wins and line-end ，、；：。 are dropped; an unsplit line breaks only after punctuation, else between Intl.Segmenter words; band/solid may run two phrases on one line (phrase 2 accent) when that fills the width better
support: sentence case, no trailing full stop (en . / zh 。), text-wrap balance
overlay never puts words on the product when product_box is known: scene shift → smaller headline → band fallback; text contrast ≥4.5:1 via the flat scrim plateau
band ≤ 30% H (4:5: 27%); the right side is never left empty (stat / brand slot / inset / headline scaled to ≥68% width)
inset only from a close-up asset (macro/detail that fills the frame, ideally warm-lit); a crop of the scene would cut the product (scene_product_cropped)
scene cover scale ≤ 1.25 of source px; the inset obeys the same cap
en pages drop any Han-bearing headline/support/figure/platform/brand text
solid: whole product in frame by default (no accidental crop), centred under the words
chip and stat captions are meta tier, values important/headline tier; chips in a row share one width
limitations: demo_only: all photos are third-party reference images with unverified rights; original branding kept, not replaced
all copy is neutral visual description, not approved product claims

modes.overlay: default when job.scene: full-bleed scene at scene_zoom (1.3) toward job.focus; text_zone top/bottom (figures → bottom; else the larger free band from job.product_box; else focus_y); a warm-dark scrim (rgba(30,22,17), 80%, 88% where the words cross the product) is flat behind every text line and fades over 200px into the photo (measured cream-on-scrim ≈10:1); with job.product_box the scene is shifted (and the headline stepped down) until the product clears the text block; if it still cannot, the page falls back to band (job.overlay_fallback=false keeps overlay)
modes.band: DeWalt variant: scene on the top 70% (4:5: 73% with a tighter 1.3 crop so the product keeps its size), hard-edged warm-dark band below with a 56px feather into the photo at the seam; stack optically centred; right side = key-figure stat (only as wide as the figure), else brand slot, else a ringed close-up (job.inset, r = 0.11W, wholly inside the band) — dropped when it would push the headline past 2 lines; with none the headline is scaled to fill ≥68% of the band (zh: both phrases on one line); landscape: dark panel left 46%
modes.solid: studio light ground with a warm floor gradient; every canvas: full-width text block on top (designed break), optional equal-width chip row, then the whole product centred below with ≥6% side and 5.5% bottom margin and a contact shadow (landscape: text left 56%, product right); job.hero_bleed>0 lets it run off the bottom; job.solid_layout='column' restores the old 0.42W text column

optional_job_fields.product_box: [x0,y0,x1,y1] normalised product box in the scene (the renderer strips the asset's _product, so it must be sent as a job field or asset.product_box); enables product-aware overlay placement, the band fallback and whole-product band crops
optional_job_fields.figures: ≤3 {icon,value,unit,label} or {icon,text,label}: overlay chip row, solid chip column/row, first numeric one → band stat
optional_job_fields.stat: {value,unit,label} key figure for the band's right half (else the first numeric figure)
optional_job_fields.inset: asset id (in job.assets) of a frame-filling close-up (e.g. macro1: strap rivet on canvas); shown as a ringed circle r=0.11W inside the band
optional_job_fields.inset_focus: [fx,fy] focus inside the inset asset (default centre)
optional_job_fields.inset_zoom: zoom over cover for the inset (default 1.25, capped at 1.25x source)
optional_job_fields.text_zone: 'top'|'bottom' to force the overlay text side
optional_job_fields.overlay_fallback: false keeps overlay even when the words would sit on the product
optional_job_fields.two_tone: false keeps the whole headline in the base colour
optional_job_fields.hero_bleed: fraction of the product height allowed off the bottom in solid mode (default 0: whole product in frame)
optional_job_fields.hero_fill: scale over the fit of the product region in solid mode (default 1; 1.15 in the column layout)
optional_job_fields.solid_layout: 'column' restores the 0.42W text column with the product beside it (default: text block on top)
